hero.gradientDescription: FPTN is a non-profit VPN, a volunteer project to bypass censorship. The VPN client is a mobile app or a lightweight program for computers, with an interface located in the system tray. No registration is required! We will send you an access token via a Telegram bot. FPTN operates through the HTTPS protocol, effectively masking traffic and allowing you to bypass censorship restrictions. The project's source code is available on GitHub.

items.title: Step One
description: Go to the Telegram bot and generate a token with the /token command, then copy it.

items.title: Step Two
description: Paste the token into the appropriate field.

items.title: Step Three
description: Log in to the app using the received token.

items.title: Step Four
description: Select a VPN server from the list of available servers (the 'Auto' mode will choose the most optimal server, or you can select a server from the list). To enable the VPN service, press the button in the center of the screen to activate the connection to the selected server.

items.title: Step One
description: Go to the Telegram bot and generate a token with the /token command, then copy it.

items.title: Step Two
description: Download and run the installer. When launching the installer, Windows will display a warning window; click 'More info'.

items.title: Step Three
description: Then click the 'Run anyway' button.

items.title: Step Four
description: After that, confirm the installer launch.

items.title: Step Five
description: After the installation is complete, press the 'Finish' button, and the application will launch automatically.

items.title: Step Six
description: After launching the client, an application icon will appear in the system tray. Click the icon and open the settings.

items.title: Step Seven
description: Click the 'Add token' button.

items.title: Step Eight
description: Paste the token from the Telegram bot here and save.

items.title: Step Nine
description: After opening, a list of available servers will appear; then simply close the settings window.

items.title: Step Ten
description: In the system tray, click the application icon and select 'Smart Connection.' 'Smart Connection' will choose the most optimal server.

raspberryPi.title: Setting Up a WiFi-VPN Access Point on Raspberry Pi

items.title: Step 1
description: Download the VPN client version for ARM and set it up following the instructions: https://github.com/batchar2/fptn?tab=readme-ov-file#fptn-client-installation-and-configuration

items.title: Step 2
description: Install the hostapd and dnsmasq packages with the command:
sudo apt install hostapd dnsmasq

items.title: Step 3
description: Stop and disable the hostapd and dnsmasq services:
sudo systemctl stop hostapd && sudo systemctl disable hostapd
sudo systemctl stop dnsmasq && sudo systemctl disable dnsmasq

items.title: Step 4
description: For Ubuntu 24.04/22.04: open /etc/systemd/resolved.conf, set DNSStubListener=no, restart the systemd-resolved service, and reboot the system.

items.title: Step 5
description: Copy hostapd/fptn-hostapd.conf and hostapd/fptn-hostapd.service to the appropriate directories.
Edit /etc/fptn-hostapd.conf, specifying the WiFi interface, SSID, and password.

items.title: Step 6
description: Copy hostapd/fptn-dnsmasq.conf and hostapd/fptn-dnsmasq.service to the appropriate directories.

items.title: Step 7
description: Copy fptn-setup-network.service to /etc/systemd/system and fptn-setup-network.sh to /usr/sbin/.
Edit fptn-setup-network.sh, specifying the WiFi and Ethernet interfaces.

items.title: Step 8
description: sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable/restart fptn-hostapd.service
sudo systemctl enable/restart fptn-dnsmasq.service
sudo systemctl enable/start fptn-setup-network.service
sudo systemctl enable/start fptn-client.service

items.title: Done!
description: After these steps, your Raspberry Pi will function as a WiFi access point with VPN.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to common questions about FPTN

questions.question: How do I get access to FPTN?
questions.answer: No registration is required! Just contact our Telegram bot, and we’ll send you an access token to connect.

questions.question: Is FPTN free?
questions.answer: Yes, FPTN is a completely free non-profit project created by volunteers to provide open internet access.

questions.question: Which devices does FPTN support?
questions.answer: FPTN is available as a mobile app for smartphones and as a lightweight program for computers with a system tray interface.

questions.question: How secure is FPTN?
questions.answer: FPTN uses the HTTPS protocol to mask traffic, providing strong encryption and protecting your data from interception.

questions.question: Can I trust the project?
questions.answer: Yes, FPTN’s source code is fully open and available on GitHub. You can review the code yourself to ensure there are no hidden features.

questions.question: Will providers detect FPTN usage?
questions.answer: FPTN operates via the HTTPS protocol, mimicking regular web traffic, making it nearly indistinguishable from standard internet browsing.

questions.question: Does FPTN affect internet speed?
questions.answer: Like any VPN, FPTN may slightly reduce connection speed, but we optimize servers to minimize performance impact.

questions.question: Are there any traffic limits?
questions.answer: We aim to provide unlimited access, but during high load periods, reasonable limits may apply to ensure stable performance for all users.

questions.question: What if my token stops working?
questions.answer: Contact our Telegram bot—we’ll quickly issue a new token. Tokens may periodically be updated for security reasons.

questions.question: Can I contribute to the project?
questions.answer: Absolutely! You can contribute to development via GitHub, help with translations, spread the word, or support the project with donations.

questions.question: Which countries does FPTN support?
questions.answer: FPTN is designed to work in regions with internet censorship. Check with our Telegram bot for up-to-date information on supported countries.

questions.question: Is technical setup required?
questions.answer: No, FPTN is designed to be user-friendly—just install the app, enter the token, and you’re ready to go.
